title: feat(011b16): on B16, (0,1,1) same-k k=4 holds; doubled and k=5 face fail
science: Parallel of #6764 with the cheaper reverser (0,1,1) on B_16(0): t(4,0,0)=8, t(8,0,0)=12, t(2,2,2)=6, t(4,4,4)=12, t(10,0,0)=14, t(5,5,0)=10; the four bits come out yes/no/yes/no, the SAME pattern as nu. Cross-cell content: the two reversers agree on which pairs reverse despite different arrival tables, so the yes/no pattern is a property of the comparator scale rather than of the particular rule.
